records.issue_text: [BUG] gen_request_data compares error timestamps sourced from nodestore event data (epoch seconds, e.g. 1.7e9) against rrweb segment event timestamps (millisecond offsets from replay start, typically small values) with a bare '<', so the two clock domains are never comparable. All fetched errors always compare as 'later' than every breadcrumb, so the chronological interleave collapses: error log messages are dumped as a tail at the end of the segment loop instead of appearing where they occurred, and the Seer summary's timeline narrative is wrong for every replay with error context.
